LanguageData.CH_WashTub.label: wash tub
LanguageData.CH_WashTub.description: A wooden tub for scrubbing clothes by hand. Anyone can use it without research, but it is slow and no substitute for a proper laundry basin.
LanguageData.CH_LaundryBasin.label: laundry basin
LanguageData.CH_LaundryBasin.description: A proper basin with a scrubbing board and room to soak several garments. Faster than a hand tub and easier on the fabric.
LanguageData.CH_WashingMachine.label: washing machine
LanguageData.CH_WashingMachine.description: An electric drum washer. It washes one dirty garment every cycle on its own as long as it has power, water and soap. Leave dirty clothes next to it.
LanguageData.CH_UltraSonicWasher.label: ultrasonic washer
LanguageData.CH_UltraSonicWasher.description: A sonic cleaning tank that shakes dirt out of fabric without scrubbing. Uses half the water and half the soap of a drum washer, and finishes in half the time.
LanguageData.CH_Soap.label: soap
LanguageData.CH_Soap.description: A bar of harsh lye soap. Washing a garment with soap lifts the dirt out completely; without it, some grime always stays behind.
